Treatment summary
Treatment summary: The patient presented after a sideswipe collision during a lane
change and reported neck and back strain. The reported mechnaism is plausible for a
collision of this type. Care has icnluded 36 visits, with near-daily attendance for
much of the period, a volume well above what is typically expected for this injury.
Additional body regions were reported several weeks after the collision and have since
been added to the treatment plan. Imaging of the cervical and lumbar spine is
unremarkable, and physical examination findings fall within normal limits. Nearly all
reported symptoms rest on the patient's own description of pain, as no objective
findings have been identified. No prior injury to the same areas is known to this
provider. Billing records reviewed show no repeated charges for the same services.
Plan: continue home exercise program, reassess function in four weeks, and consider
tapering visit frequency as symptoms allow.

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.
